q.q: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
c: To confirm that a payment has been received
To ask about available catering menu options
To request a change to an existing order
To report a problem with a recent delivery
q.n: メール本文で「eight more standard lunch boxes を追加したい／それ以外は予約どおりで」と書いており、既存注文 HOC-2291 への追加変更依頼が目的。支払い受領の確認ではなく、逆に更新後の請求書を送ってほしいと頼んでいる点で受領確認は誤り。メニュー内容を尋ねてもおらず(すでに発注済み)、配達の不具合報告でもない(配達は3月20日でまだ先)。

q.q: Why will Ms. Radcliffe most likely be charged a surcharge?
c: She canceled part of her order within 48 hours of delivery.
She ordered more standard lunch boxes than the seminar allowed.
She submitted her change fewer than four days before delivery.
She changed the delivery address after placing the order.
q.n: 注文フォームの規定「変更は配達日の少なくとも4日前までに受領、それ以降は追加分に10%の追加料金」と、配達日が3月20日である点を、メールの日付3月18日と突合する。3月18日は配達のわずか2日前で締切(3月16日)を過ぎているため追加料金の対象。キャンセルではなく追加なので48時間キャンセル規定は無関係で、フォームだけ読むと引っかかる誤答。数量に上限を設ける規定はフォームのどこにもない。住所変更もしておらず、追加するのは標準弁当で配送先は同じ。

q.q: Before any surcharge, how much will the additional lunch boxes add to the order?
q.n: メールで追加を依頼しているのは standard lunch box を8個。注文フォームの単価表で standard lunch box は1個 $15.50。$15.50 × 8 = $124.00 が追加料金前の金額。$136.40 は10%の追加料金を上乗せした額で「追加料金前」という問いに反する引っかけ。$152.00 は誤って deluxe lunch box の単価 $19.00 × 8 を使ったもの。$167.20 は deluxe 単価にさらに10%を足した二重の誤り。

q.q: In the e-mail, the word "accommodate" is closest in meaning to
q.n: 該当箇所は「could you accommodate this last-minute change(この直前の変更に応じていただけますか)」で、依頼を受け入れる・かなえるの意。よって grant(応じる・許可する)が最も近い。house は「宿泊させる/収容する」で人や物を泊める意味が中心でここでは不自然。enlarge は「拡大する」で変更に応じる意ではない。locate は「位置を突き止める」で全く別の意味。

q.q: What is NOT listed on the order form?
q.n: 注文フォームの品目表には Standard lunch box、Deluxe lunch box、Seasonal fruit platter が並び、さらに Delivery fee $18.00 の行もある。よってフルーツプラター・配達料・標準弁当はいずれも記載あり。飲み物(hot drinks)の項目はフォームのどこにも無いため、記載されていないものはホットドリンクの詰め合わせ。

p7.intro: Questions 181-185 refer to the following article and review.

docs.h: ScreenMender Mobile: The Repair Shop That Drives to You
docs.b:
www.gadgetdispatch.com/features/screenmender-mobile
[ Home ]  [ Features ]  [ Deals ]  [ Sign In ]

Tired of leaving your cracked phone at a counter for a week? ScreenMender Mobile has rewritten the rulebook. Launched by founder Diego Varga, the company sends certified technicians directly to a customer's home or office in a fully equipped van, so there is nothing to drop off and nothing to pick up.

Standard repairs are scheduled two to three business days after a request is submitted. Customers who join the MenderPlus program, however, unlock same-day booking and receive 15 percent off every replacement part. Membership runs 8.50 dollars per month and can be canceled at any time.

Every repair is backed by a 90-day warranty. For now the service covers only the central district, but Varga confirmed that coverage will extend to the neighboring town of Ostwick beginning September 3.

Overall rating: 5 out of 5
Posted: September 18

I had heard good things, so when my screen shattered I decided to try ScreenMender Mobile myself. I live in Ostwick, and honestly I assumed I would have to drive all the way into the city. Instead, a technician pulled up outside my apartment the very same afternoon I booked.

Before scheduling, I signed up for MenderPlus, which turned out to be a smart move — the discount alone nearly covered the monthly fee. The whole process was remarkably smooth, and the new screen looks flawless. My only small complaint is that the van arrived about twenty minutes late, though the technician did call ahead to let me know.

I will definitely keep my membership for the peace of mind the warranty provides.

q.q: What is the main purpose of the article?
c: To introduce a mobile phone repair service
To announce an increase in membership fees
To compare two competing repair companies
To recruit technicians for a new location
q.n: 記事は冒頭からサービスの仕組み(技術者がバンで自宅や職場へ出張して修理する)を紹介している。値上げの告知でも、2社の比較でも、技術者の求人でもない。

q.q: Why most likely was Ms. Rasathurai able to receive a repair on the same day she booked?
c: She lives in the central district
She enrolled in the MenderPlus program
q.n: 記事に「MenderPlus会員は同日予約が可能になる」とあり、レビューでは評者が予約前にMenderPlusへ登録したと述べている。レビュー単体では同日対応が会員特典によるものだと分からず、記事の規定と突合して初めて理由が確定する。中央地区在住は誤り(評者はOstwick在住)、通常予約は2〜3営業日かかるので当日は不可、追加料金の記述はどちらの文書にもない。

q.q: What is suggested about ScreenMender Mobile's expansion to Ostwick?
c: It was postponed until the following year
It was canceled because of low demand
It is available only to MenderPlus members
q.n: 記事は9月3日からOstwickへサービスを拡大予定と述べ、レビューは9月18日付でOstwick在住の評者が実際に出張修理を受けたことを示している。両者を突合すると拡大は予定通り実施されたと分かる。記事だけを読むと「予定(未実施)」に見え延期や中止と取り違えやすいが、9月3日以降の日付でOstwickの評者が受けたレビューが実施を裏づける。会員限定という記述もない。

q.q: In the review, the word "smooth" is closest in meaning to
q.n: ここでの smooth は手続きが「順調で支障がない」という意味で、trouble-free が最も近い。polished(洗練された)、flat(平らな)、quiet(静かな)は文脈に合わない。

q.q: What does Ms. Rasathurai mention as a drawback of her experience?
c: The final cost was higher than advertised
The technician arrived later than expected
The warranty period was too short
q.n: レビュー後半で唯一の不満として「バンが約20分遅れて到着した」と述べている。費用が広告より高かった、画面が再び割れた、保証期間が短すぎるといった不満は述べていない。

Special Programming Announcement

Coastline Community Radio is proud to broadcast live from the Lantern Bay Seafood Fair this Saturday, July 18. During these three hours on Saturday, the program that normally fills our afternoon slot will not air. It will return to its regular schedule the next day. Listeners who cannot attend the fair in person are welcome to stream the full coverage on our website. A recording will also be posted under the Events tab by Sunday evening.

9:00 A.M. – 1:00 P.M.  |  Harbour Talk (Host: Priya Nandel)
Call-in discussions on community issues and local business.

1:00 P.M. – 4:00 P.M.  |  The Afternoon Drift (Host: Colin Radek)
Music, listener requests, and coverage of the local arts scene.

4:00 P.M. – 7:00 P.M.  |  Evening Currents (Host: Melina Voss)
Interviews and the evening wrap-up. Weather update at 6:00 P.M. with Gordon Pyle.

To: Coastline Community Radio <feedback@coastlinecommunityradio.org>
From: Harriet Colven
Date: July 15
Subject: Fair coverage and weekend weather

Hello,

I have been a loyal listener for years, and I was thrilled to hear that you will be reporting from the Lantern Bay Seafood Fair. I plan to bring my grandchildren on Saturday.

However, when I tuned in yesterday evening at about 6:00 P.M., the forecast mentioned a chance of heavy rain over the weekend. Could you let me know whether the outdoor booth will still operate if the weather turns poor? I would hate for the children to be disappointed.

Also, I usually listen to the one o'clock program every afternoon, so I was a little sad to learn it will be off the air that day. Will those interviews be repeated later?

Thank you for all you do.

Harriet Colven

q.q: What is the main purpose of the web page?
c: To introduce a newly hired radio host
To report the results of a listener survey
To announce special coverage of a local event
q.n: Webページは Lantern Bay Seafood Fair から live broadcast する特別編成の告知で、地域イベントの特別中継を知らせるのが目的。新しい司会の紹介はどの文書にもない。寄付の呼びかけも述べていない。視聴者アンケートの結果報告でもなく、視聴者へ中継を案内している。

q.q: Whose program will most likely be off the air during the fair coverage?
q.n: Webページの特別中継は 1:00 P.M.–4:00 P.M. で、その時間の通常番組は放送されないと明記。番組表の同じ時間帯を突合するとその枠は The Afternoon Drift（司会 Colin Radek）なので、Colin Radek の番組が休止する。番組表は Daily Lineup で土曜も同じ編成のためこの突合が成立する。Desmond Farr は 6–9 A.M. の朝枠で無関係。Priya Nandel は 9 A.M.–1 P.M. 枠で1時に終わるだけで休止対象ではない（番組表だけ見ると1時つながりで引っかかる誤答）。Melina Voss は 4–7 P.M. 枠で中継時間外。

q.q: Who most likely presented the forecast that Ms. Colven heard?
q.n: メールは Ms. Colven が「昨夕 about 6:00 P.M. に聞いた」と述べる。番組表の 6:00 P.M. の weather update 担当は Gordon Pyle なので彼が該当し、メールの時刻と番組表の担当者を突合して初めて特定できる。Sana Okafor は 7:00 A.M. の朝の気象担当で時間帯が違う（朝と夕方の予報を混同させる誤答）。Melina Voss はその 4–7 P.M. 枠の司会だが気象予報士ではない（番組表だけ見て時間帯の司会名を選ぶ引っかけ）。Desmond Farr は朝枠の司会で無関係。

q.q: In the e-mail, the word "loyal" is closest in meaning to
q.n: ここでの loyal listener は長年ずっと支持している熱心な聴取者の意で、devoted が最も近い。honest は「正直な」で忠実さの意味とは別。wealthy は「裕福な」で文脈と無関係。frequent は「頻繁な」で意味圏は近いが、loyal が表すのは頻度ではなく愛着・忠誠なので不適（意味圏を寄せた誤答）。

q.q: According to the web page, how can people who do not attend the fair follow the coverage?
c: By calling in to the station during the broadcast
By subscribing to a printed newsletter
By visiting the north pier on Sunday
By streaming it on the station's website
q.n: Webページは現地に行けない聴取者は website で中継を stream できると案内しているので、ウェブでのストリーミングが答え。放送中に電話をかける方法は述べていない。north pier は土曜当日のブース設置場所で、Sunday に行くのは録画が Sunday evening までに投稿される話と混同させる誤答。印刷ニュースレターの購読には触れていない。

The Ellsworth Short Story Prize — Entry Guidelines

The Ellsworth Short Story Prize is now accepting entries for this year's competition. All stories must be previously unpublished and written in English. Entries are accepted in two categories:

Open Category
- For writers who have already published at least one book.
- Maximum length: 5,000 words.
- Entry fee: $40.
- Applicants must enclose a one-page author biography.

Emerging Writer Category
- For writers who have never published a book.
- Maximum length: 3,000 words.
- Entry fee: $25.
- Applicants must enclose a signed eligibility statement confirming that they have not previously published a book.

Key dates
- Submission deadline: March 15.
- Winners will be notified by e-mail during April.
- Awards reception: May 9.

Complete the online entry form under the "Submit" tab. Entry fees are non-refundable.

docs.h: The Ellsworth Short Story Prize — Official Entry Form
docs.b:
Applicant Name: Yusuf Demir
E-mail Address: y.demir@mailhub.net
Category (select one):    Open [ ]    Emerging Writer [X]
Story Title: The Salt Road
Word Count: 2,850 words
Required enclosure attached:    Yes [X]    No [ ]
Date submitted: March 3

By submitting this form, I confirm that the enclosed information is accurate and that the story is my own original, previously unpublished work.

To: Yusuf Demir <y.demir@mailhub.net>
From: Marisol Peña <mpena@ellsworthprize.org>
Date: April 14
Subject: Congratulations — Ellsworth Short Story Prize

Dear Mr. Demir,

Thank you for entering the Ellsworth Short Story Prize this year. I am delighted to tell you that your story has been chosen as the winner of the category you entered. The judges praised its original voice and careful pacing.

Please note one change to the schedule. Because of a venue conflict, the awards reception has been moved to May 16 and will begin at 6:30 P.M. Winners are invited to read a short excerpt from their own story during the evening.

Kindly reply to this message by May 2 to confirm that you will attend. If you have any questions, feel free to contact me directly.

Warm regards,
Marisol Peña
Prize Coordinator

q.q: According to the Web page, what is required of applicants in the Open Category?
c: They must have already published at least one book.
They must keep their story under 3,000 words.
They must pay a fee of $25.
q.n: Web要項のOpen Category欄に「For writers who have already published at least one book」とあり、既刊書のある書き手向けの部門だと明記されている。first-time writers(初めての書き手)は逆の条件で、Emerging Writer Category向けなので誤り。3,000語未満という選択肢と$25という選択肢はいずれもEmerging Writer Categoryの数値で、Open Categoryは5,000語・$40。片方の部門の条件をもう一方に取り違えると引っかかる。

q.q: What did Yusuf Demir most likely enclose with his entry?
c: A copy of a published book
A list of previously published books
q.n: 応募フォームでYusuf DemirはEmerging Writer Categoryにチェックを入れている。Web要項のEmerging Writer欄では、この部門の応募者はsigned eligibility statement(未刊行を確認する署名入り資格証明書)の同封が必要と定めているので、フォームの選択部門と要項の同封要件を突合すると同封物が特定できる。one-page author biographyはOpen Categoryの同封要件で、要項だけ流し読みするとこちらに引っかかる。残る二つは既刊書を前提とする内容で、未刊行が条件のEmerging Writer応募者には当てはまらない。

q.q: What will Mr. Demir most likely read aloud at the awards reception?
c: An excerpt from The Salt Road
A list of the judges' comments
q.n: メール(第三文書)は受賞者に対し、レセプションで自分の作品から短い一節を朗読するよう招いている。応募フォーム(第二文書)によればYusuf Demirの作品名はThe Salt Roadなので、メールの朗読案内とフォームの作品名を突合すると朗読対象が特定できる。one-page author biographyはOpen Categoryの同封物、signed eligibility statementはEmerging Writerの同封物で、いずれも要項に登場する語だが朗読するものではなく、文書を取り違えると引っかかる。judges' commentsはメールで審査員が講評したとの記述はあるが、朗読するのは受賞者自身の作品でありコメント一覧ではない。

q.q: When will the awards reception be held?
q.n: Web要項は当初の会期をMay 9としているが、Marisol Peñaのメールが会場都合でreceptionをMay 16に変更したと通知しているため、要項とメールを突合した更新後の日付が答えになる。May 9は変更前の日程で、要項だけ読むとこの誤答に引っかかる典型。May 2は出欠返信の締切、April 14はメールの送信日で、いずれもレセプション当日ではない。

q.q: In the e-mail, the word "moved" is closest in meaning to
q.n: メールでは「the awards reception has been moved to May 16」と、行事の開催日を別の日に移した文脈でmovedが使われているため、日程を組み直す意味のrescheduledが最も近い。transferredは物や権利を移す語感で日程変更には合わない。removedは「取りやめる・削除する」で、レセプションは中止ではなく実施されるので不適。deliveredは「届ける」で文意と無関係。

p7.intro: Questions 196-200 refer to the following webpage and two e-mails.

docs.b:
[ About ]  [ Schedule ]  [ Tickets ]  [ Directions ]
www.halbrookmuseum.org/lectures/autumn

The Halbrook Museum Lecture Series — "Voices in Restoration"

All sessions are held in Ferndale Hall. Each talk runs from 2:00 P.M. to 3:30 P.M. and is followed by a short question-and-answer period.

Saturday, October 4
Pigments of the Renaissance — Dr. Marisol Fenn
How conservators identify and recreate the mineral colors used by fifteenth-century painters.

Saturday, October 11
Reading Cracks: Structural Analysis in Panel Paintings — Prof. Declan Ruiz
What the pattern of surface cracks reveals about a wooden panel's age and its past repairs.

Saturday, October 18
Textiles and Time — Dr. Hana Vestergaard
The special challenges of cleaning and storing centuries-old fabrics and tapestries.

Saturday, October 25
The Ethics of Repair — Mr. Omar Delacroix
When should a damaged work be restored, and when should its damage be preserved as part of its history?

Seating is limited. Museum members may reserve one week before the general public.

To: Theo Brandt <tbrandt@halbrookmuseum.org>
From: Dr. Aya Kimura <a.kimura@northfield-conservation.org>
Date: September 8
Subject: Filling in for the opening session

Dear Mr. Brandt,

Thank you for inviting me to join the autumn series in place of Dr. Marisol Fenn, who I understand has had to withdraw. I am glad to step in, and my talk, "Conservation in the Digital Age," is already prepared.

There is one complication. Dr. Fenn was scheduled for the opening Saturday, but I will be attending a research symposium abroad and will not return until October 12. Presenting on her original date is therefore impossible for me.

Would it be possible to place me on the final Saturday of the series instead? That would give me ample time to prepare after I get back.

I appreciate your flexibility.

Best regards,
Aya Kimura

To: Dr. Aya Kimura <a.kimura@northfield-conservation.org>
From: Theo Brandt <tbrandt@halbrookmuseum.org>
Date: September 10
Subject: RE: Filling in for the opening session

Dear Dr. Kimura,

Thank you for agreeing to join us on such short notice. I am afraid the date you asked for is not available — it is already reserved for Mr. Omar Delacroix, and we never schedule two lectures on the same afternoon.

Here is what I can offer. Dr. Hana Vestergaard has generously agreed to take over the now-vacant opening slot, which frees up her own Saturday for you. That date falls comfortably after your return, so I hope it suits you. Everyone else will keep their original session.

Please confirm and I will update both the printed program and the website. The topic descriptions are due to the printer by September 20, so an early reply would be a great help.

Warm regards,
Theo Brandt
Program Coordinator, Halbrook Museum

q.q: Why did Dr. Kimura write the first e-mail?
c: To decline the museum's invitation to speak
To ask that her session be scheduled for a later date
To recommend someone to replace Dr. Fenn
To request a larger room for her lecture
q.n: 最初のメール(Kimura→Brandt)の用件を問う。Fennの代役は引き受けたうえで、元の開幕日には海外出張で登壇できないと述べ、シリーズ最終土曜への変更を願い出ている。したがって用件はセッションを後の日程に移してほしいという依頼にあたる。彼女自身が代役として招かれているので誰かを推薦しているわけではなく、招待を辞退してもいない。より広い部屋の要求は本文のどこにも述べられていない。

q.q: What was the topic of the lecture that Dr. Kimura was invited to replace?
c: The mineral colors used by Renaissance painters
The digital tools used in modern conservation work
The cleaning and storage of antique textiles
When damage should be preserved rather than repaired
q.n: 最初のメールでKimuraは『Dr. Marisol Fennの代役』として招かれたとだけ述べ、Fennの演題自体には触れていない。一方、日程表を見るとFennの担当(10月4日)は『Pigments of the Renaissance』で、15世紀の画家が用いた鉱物顔料の同定と再現がテーマ。この2文書を突合して初めて、彼女が引き継ぐはずだった講演の主題がルネサンス期の鉱物顔料だと分かる。デジタル関連の選択肢はKimura自身の演題『Conservation in the Digital Age』であって代役対象の講演ではなく、メールだけを読むと引っかかる誤答。テキスタイルの洗浄・保管はVestergaard、損傷を残すか修復するかの倫理はDelacroixの演題で、いずれも日程表だけを見た別講師のトピック。

q.q: On which date will Dr. Kimura most likely give her lecture?
q.n: 返信メールでBrandtは『Vestergaardが空いた開幕枠を引き受け、その結果として彼女自身の土曜が空くのでそこに入ってほしい』と伝えている。日程表でVestergaardの担当は10月18日。両文書を突合するとKimuraの登壇日は10月18日となる。10月4日はVestergaardが移動してくる開幕枠(元Fenn)、10月11日はRuiz、10月25日はKimuraが当初希望したがDelacroixに予約済みの枠であり、いずれも誤り。

q.q: In the first e-mail, the word "ample" is closest in meaning to
q.n: 最初のメールの "ample time to prepare" における ample は『十分すぎるほどの、あり余る』の意で、plentiful が最も近い。brief(短い)や limited(限られた)は逆方向の意味で、equal(等しい)は文脈に合わない。

q.q: What is indicated about Dr. Hana Vestergaard?
c: She has withdrawn from the series.
She will present on an earlier Saturday than first planned.
She has changed the topic of her talk.
She will share her session with Dr. Kimura.
q.n: 日程表ではVestergaardの担当は10月18日。返信メールでは彼女が空席となった開幕枠(10月4日)を引き受けると述べられている。両文書を突合すると当初より早い土曜に登壇することになると分かる。シリーズを降りたのはFennであってVestergaardではなく、話題の変更やKimuraとの同時開催は本文に根拠がない。

p7.intro: Questions 147-148 refer to the following sign.

docs.h: Notice to All Members - Meadowgate Fitness Studio
docs.b:
The east-wing locker rooms will be closed for repainting from Monday, August 3, through Wednesday, August 5. During this period, members may use the temporary changing area next to the reception desk. Lockers in the west wing remain open as usual.

Please remove all personal belongings from east-wing lockers before August 3. Any items left behind will be moved to the front office. We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your cooperation.

- Meadowgate Facilities Team

q.q: What is the purpose of the notice?
c: To introduce a new membership plan
To announce a temporary closure of certain facilities
To advertise a grand reopening celebration
To request payment of overdue membership fees
q.n: 掲示の主旨は east-wing locker rooms が repainting のため一時閉鎖されるという告知なので「一部設備の一時閉鎖の告知」が正解。新プラン紹介・再オープンの祝賀・料金の督促はいずれも本文に一切登場しない無関係な内容。

q.q: According to the notice, what should members do before August 3?
c: Report to the front office in person
Sign up to use the temporary changing area
Move their belongings into the west-wing lockers
Remove their belongings from the east-wing lockers
q.n: 本文の Please remove all personal belongings from east-wing lockers before August 3 の言い換えが正解。「front office へ出向く」という選択肢は、残された荷物が front office へ移されるだけという記述を会員本人の行動にすり替えた罠。「west-wing ロッカーへ荷物を移す」は west wing が開いたままという事実を取り違えたfact-swap。「臨時更衣スペースの利用登録」は本文にない手続き。

p7.intro: Questions 149-151 refer to the following form.

docs.h: Thornbury Community Garden - Plot Rental Application
docs.b:
Applicant Name: Mr. Diego Longoria
Address: 14 Fennwick Lane, Oakmont
Telephone: 555-0182
E-mail: d.longoria@mailhub.example

Plot size requested:
[ ] Small (3 x 3 m) - $40 per season
[X] Medium (3 x 6 m) - $70 per season
[ ] Large (6 x 6 m) - $120 per season

Preferred watering shift (check one):
[X] Morning (6:00 A.M. - 8:00 A.M.)
[ ] Evening (6:00 P.M. - 8:00 P.M.)

Have you rented a plot here before?   [ ] Yes   [X] No

Would you like to join the monthly gardening workshop?   [X] Yes   [ ] No

Comments: I would like a plot that receives full afternoon sun, as I plan to grow tomatoes.

--- Office use only ---
Application received: July 12
Plot assigned: B-17
Season begins: August 1

q.q: What is suggested about Mr. Longoria?
c: He prefers to water his plot in the evening
He is renting a garden plot at Thornbury for the first time
He has requested the largest available plot
He is a member of the garden office staff
q.n: Have you rented a plot here before? に No とチェックしているので「初めての利用者」が推論として正解。「夕方に水やりしたい」は Morning にチェックした事実を Evening にすり替えたfact-swap。「一番大きい区画を希望」は選んだのが Medium なのに Large にすり替えた罠。「菜園事務局のスタッフ」は Office use only 欄の存在を悪用した根拠のない飛躍。

q.q: How much will Mr. Longoria most likely pay for the season?
q.n: Medium (3 x 6 m) にチェックしており料金は $70 なのでこれが正解。$40 は Small、$120 は Large の料金を本人の選択にすり替えたfact-swap。$110 はどの区画にも対応しないダミー金額。

q.q: Which of the following did Mr. Longoria indicate on the form?
c: He would rather water his plot in the evening
He wishes to attend the monthly gardening workshop
He has grown vegetables at the garden in past seasons
He needs a plot in a fully shaded location
q.n: monthly gardening workshop の欄で Yes にチェックしているので参加希望が正解。「夕方に水やりしたい」は Morning を選んだ事実を逆にしたfact-swap。「過去に野菜を育てた」は「以前借りたことはない(No)」という事実と矛盾。「日陰の区画が必要」は Comments 欄の full afternoon sun（日当たり良好を希望）と正反対にすり替えた罠。

p7.intro: Questions 152-153 refer to the following form.

docs.b:
Employee: Mr. Rahul Mittal
Department: Market Research
Trip purpose: Client visit in Port Alden
Dates of travel: September 8 - September 10

| Date | Category | Description | Amount |
| Sept 8 | Transport | Train ticket (round trip) | $84.50 |
| Sept 8 | Lodging | Harbourview Inn, 2 nights | $210.00 |
| Sept 9 | Meals | Lunch with client | $46.75 |
| Sept 10 | Transport | Taxi to the station | $18.20 |

Total requested: $359.45

Note: Per company policy, meal expenses are reimbursed only up to $40.00 per person per day. Any amount exceeding this limit is the employee's own responsibility.

q.q: How much did Mr. Mittal spend on lodging?
q.n: 表の Lodging 行 Harbourview Inn, 2 nights は $210.00 なのでこれが正解。$84.50 は Transport（電車）、$46.75 は Meals（昼食）の金額を宿泊費にすり替えたfact-swap。$359.45 は Total requested を単一項目と取り違えさせる罠。

q.q: Which expense will Riverbend Consulting most likely NOT reimburse in full?
q.n: Note のポリシー『meals は1人1日 $40.00 まで』と表の Lunch $46.75 を突き合わせると、昼食が上限を $6.75 超えるため全額は払い戻されない。よって Lunch が正解。Transport（train, taxi）と Lodging には金額上限の規定がなく、ポリシー文が及ばないので払い戻し対象外にはならない。

p7.intro: Questions 154-155 refer to the following text-message chain.

docs.b:
Camila Barrios (2:10 P.M.): Hi Jun-ho, did the backdrop stands arrive at the studio yet?

Jun-ho Baek (2:12 P.M.): They just got here. Two boxes, but one of them looks damaged.

Camila Barrios (2:13 P.M.): Damaged how? Can we still use it for the 4 o'clock shoot?

Jun-ho Baek (2:15 P.M.): The frame is badly bent. I wouldn't risk it. Let me call the rental company.

Camila Barrios (2:16 P.M.): Good idea. If they can't swap it by 3:30, we'll have to push everything back.

q.q: At 2:15 P.M., what does Mr. Baek most likely mean when he writes, "I wouldn't risk it"?
c: He believes the photo shoot should be cancelled
He is unwilling to spend money on a replacement
He does not want to call the rental company
He thinks the damaged stand should not be used
q.n: 直前で The frame is badly bent と言い、直後に交換のため rental company へ電話すると続くので、『曲がった台はもう使わない方がいい』という判断を表している。risk を辞書的に『金銭を賭ける＝出費』と読むのは literal-trap で、文脈は金銭ではなく機材の使用可否の話。直後に自分から電話すると言っているため『誰かに連絡させたい』は矛盾。4 o'clock shoot は延期の可能性が出ただけで撮影中止とは述べていない。

q.q: What does Mr. Baek say he will do next?
q.n: 2:15 P.M. の Let me call the rental company が根拠で「レンタル会社に連絡する」が正解。「4時の撮影を中止」は 4 o'clock shoot という語を使いつつ中止にすり替えたfact-swap（実際は 3:30 までに交換できなければ後ろ倒し）。「箱を両方返す」は damaged なのが two boxes のうち one だけなので誤り。「曲がった台を自分で修理する」とは述べていない。

p7.intro: Questions 156-158 refer to the following e-mail.

docs.b:
To: Ms. Fatima Mosala <f.mosala@mailhub.example>
From: Mr. Anton Pfeiffer <a.pfeiffer@harlowsupply.example>
Date: October 4
Subject: Your recent order (#48821)

Dear Ms. Mosala,

Thank you for the office-supply order you placed on October 2. - [1] - We are writing to let you know that one item, the box of A4 notebooks, is currently out of stock. - [2] - The remaining items in your order have already been shipped and should reach you by October 7.

We expect the notebooks to be back in stock within two weeks. - [3] - As a token of our apology, we have added a 10 percent discount to your next purchase. - [4] - The discount code will be e-mailed to you as soon as the notebooks ship.

If you would instead prefer a refund for the out-of-stock item, simply reply to this message and we will process it right away.

Sincerely,
Anton Pfeiffer
Customer Service, Harlow Stationery Supply

q.q: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
c: To notify a customer that part of an order cannot be shipped immediately
To confirm that a complete order has already been delivered
To request payment for a recent purchase
To advertise a new line of notebooks
q.n: one item ... is currently out of stock を知らせ、残りは発送済みと伝えるのが目的なので『注文の一部をすぐ発送できないと知らせる』が正解。B は The remaining items だけが発送済みで注文全部が届いたわけではない点をすり替えたfact-swap。C の支払い請求、D の新商品宣伝は本文にない。

q.q: What is Ms. Mosala offered as an apology?
c: A discount on a future purchase
Free shipping on her current order
A replacement item at no charge
An extended period to return items
q.n: As a token of our apology, we have added a 10 percent discount to your next purchase が根拠で『今後の購入への割引』が正解。B の送料無料、C の無償代替品、D の返品期間延長はいずれも本文に述べられておらず、詫びの内容を別のサービスにすり替えた誤答。

q.q: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "You will not be charged for it until it is ready to ship."
q.n: 挿入文の it は在庫切れの A4 notebooks を指し、『発送準備が整うまで請求しない』という補足。品切れを告げた直後の [2] に置くと it の指す物が直前で明示され自然につながる。[1] はまだ品切れの品に触れておらず it が指すものがない。[3][4] は再入荷や割引の話に移っており、請求の補足が割り込むと流れが途切れる。

p7.intro: Questions 159-160 refer to the following notice.

docs.b:
The Town of Calderhaven will begin enforcing Ordinance 22-B, which governs overnight street parking, on 1 September. Under the new rule, any vehicle left on a public street between 2:00 A.M. and 5:00 A.M. must display a valid overnight permit on the driver-side windshield.

Residents may apply for permits at the Municipal Services Office on Halden Row. The annual fee is $45.00 per vehicle, and permits are issued only to individuals who can show proof of residence within town limits. Vehicles parked without a visible permit during restricted hours will receive a $60.00 citation.

The ordinance does not apply to marked commercial delivery vehicles or to the two municipal parking structures on Ferrey Street, both of which remain open at all hours.

q.q: What is the purpose of the notice?
c: To advertise a reduction in the annual permit fee
To announce the opening of a municipal parking structure
To inform residents of a new street-parking requirement
To warn drivers about upcoming road construction
q.n: 掲示全体が9月1日から施行される深夜駐車の新ルール（許可証の掲示義務）を住民に知らせるもの。Ferrey Street の市営駐車場（parking structures）は「常時開放」で例外として触れているだけで、開設の告知ではない（本文の別事実を目的にすり替えたダミー）。許可証の値下げや道路工事には一切言及がない。

q.q: What is indicated about the municipal parking structures on Ferrey Street?
c: They require a $45.00 permit to enter
They are available at any time of day
They may be used only between 2:00 A.M. and 5:00 A.M.
They are reserved for commercial delivery vehicles
q.n: 本文末尾に Ferrey Street の2つの駐車場は「remain open at all hours（常時開放）」とあり、これが正解。$45.00 は路上駐車の年間許可証の料金で駐車場入場料ではない（金額の付け替え）。2:00-5:00 A.M. は路上駐車が制限される時間帯であって駐車場の利用時間ではない（時間帯の付け替え）。配送車両は路上駐車ルールの適用外というだけで駐車場が配送車専用とは書かれていない。

p7.intro: Questions 161-163 refer to the following article.

docs.h: Northmere Ceramics Announces Coastal Production Plant
docs.b:
FENWICK BAY — Northmere Ceramics, a manufacturer of household tableware, confirmed on Tuesday that it will build a new production facility near the Fenwick Bay harbor district. The plant, scheduled to open next spring, is expected to create roughly 240 full-time positions and will supply the company's growing export business across the northern coastal region.

"For a decade our sales have outpaced what our single inland factory can produce," said Ms. Adaeze Nwokolo, chief executive officer of Northmere Ceramics. "This site lets us cut shipping times to our overseas buyers and finally meet demand we have had to turn away." Ms. Nwokolo added that the firm intends to source its clay from suppliers within the province rather than importing it, a shift she said would trim material costs by about 15 percent.

q.q: What is suggested about Northmere Ceramics?
c: It has been in business for only a short time
It currently imports most of the tableware it sells
It plans to shut down its inland factory next spring
It has been unable to fill all of the orders it receives
q.n: CEO が「sales have outpaced production」「demand we have had to turn away（断ってきた需要）」と述べており、注文をさばききれていないと推測できる。輸入しているのは製品ではなく将来の粘土（しかも今後は域内調達に切替）なので製品輸入は誤り。inland factory は言及されるが閉鎖するとは書かれていない（新工場は spring 開業＝別事実の付け替え）。'For a decade' とあり創業まもなくは本文と矛盾。

q.q: According to the article, how does the company plan to reduce its material costs?
c: By purchasing clay from suppliers within the province
By shortening shipping times to overseas buyers
By locating the plant in the harbor district
q.n: 第2段落で「輸入せず域内（province）の業者から粘土を仕入れることで材料費を約15%削減できる」と明言している。240 の雇用創出は工場の効果だが材料費削減の手段ではない（数字の付け替え）。輸送時間短縮は海外バイヤー向けの別の利点で材料費とは無関係。港湾地区への立地は場所の話で費用削減策そのものではない。

q.q: In the article, the word "trim" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
q.n: ここでの trim は「trim material costs by about 15 percent＝費用を減らす」なので reduce が最も近い。decorate は trim の辞書的な別義「（縁を）飾る・切りそろえる」に引っ張られた罠で、費用を『飾る』は文意が通らない。organize は整理の意味で数値削減にならず、extend は逆に増やす方向で矛盾する。

p7.intro: Questions 164-167 refer to the following schedule.

docs.b:
Venue: Port Delwyn Conference Hall. Badges may be collected at the registration desk from 8:30 A.M. Lunch is not provided; several cafes operate nearby.

9:00 A.M. - 9:45 A.M. | Opening Keynote: Feeding the Northern Belt
Dr. Soo-jin Baek, director of the Delwyn Crop Institute, reviews regional yield trends over the past twenty years.

10:00 A.M. - 11:15 A.M. | Saltwater Intrusion and Soil Health
Mr. Tomas Herrera, a soil scientist, explains how rising sea levels are affecting the drainage of farmland along the coast.

11:30 A.M. - 12:30 P.M. | Panel: Financing Small Farms
Moderated by Ms. Priya Nair, an agricultural loan officer, with three regional growers.

12:30 P.M. - 1:30 P.M. | Lunch break

1:30 P.M. - 2:45 P.M. | Precision Irrigation Workshop
Dr. Rahim Chowdhury, an engineer, gives a hands-on demonstration of sensor-based watering systems. Attendance is limited to 30 participants.

3:00 P.M. - 4:00 P.M. | Closing Roundtable
All speakers return to take questions from the audience.

q.q: What is indicated about the Precision Irrigation Workshop?
c: The number of participants is capped at 30
It takes place immediately before the lunch break
It is led by Dr. Soo-jin Baek
It is the first session of the day
q.n: ワークショップの説明に「Attendance is limited to 30 participants」とあり定員30名が正解。開始は1:30 P.M.でランチ（12:30-1:30）の直後なので『直前』は時間の付け替えで誤り。担当は Dr. Rahim Chowdhury で Dr. Baek は開会基調講演の講演者（人物の付け替え）。最初のセッションは9:00の基調講演。

q.q: What is suggested about Ms. Priya Nair?
c: She studies the effects of seawater on soil
She works in the field of farm lending
She directs the Delwyn Crop Institute
q.n: Ms. Nair は「agricultural loan officer」として資金調達パネルの司会を務めるので、農業融資の分野で働いていると推測できる。海水と土壌の研究は Mr. Herrera、Crop Institute の所長は Dr. Baek、センサー式灌漑機器は Dr. Chowdhury の担当で、いずれも別人の役割を付け替えたダミー。

q.q: Who most likely will speak about the effects of rising sea levels?
q.n: 海面上昇の影響は「Saltwater Intrusion and Soil Health」で扱われ、講演者は Mr. Tomas Herrera。Dr. Chowdhury は灌漑（水は関係するが海面上昇ではない）という近い分野の罠。Dr. Baek は収量推移、Ms. Nair は資金調達の司会で話題が異なる。

q.q: According to the programme, what will take place at 3:00 P.M.?
c: A roundtable in which all speakers answer questions
q.n: 3:00-4:00 P.M. は「Closing Roundtable」で全講演者が聴衆の質問に答える。バッジ受取は8:30 A.M.から、基調講演は9:00 A.M.、ランチは12:30 P.M.からで、いずれも別時間帯の出来事を付け替えたダミー。

p7.intro: Questions 168-171 refer to the following online chat discussion.

docs.b:
Harlan Voss [8:12 A.M.]: Morning, all. The freight company just told me our banner crates won't reach the Kessler Expo Center until noon. Doors open to buyers at 1.

Meiling Tan [8:14 A.M.]: That cuts it close. Can we set up the tables and product samples first and hang the banners last?

Diego Ferraro [8:15 A.M.]: The tables are already here — I picked them up yesterday. I can have the sample shelves assembled by 10.

Harlan Voss [8:16 A.M.]: Good. Meiling, could you meet the freight truck at the loading dock so the crates don't sit around?

Meiling Tan [8:17 A.M.]: I'm tied up on the booth graphics, but I could step away around noon if I have to.

Nadia Okonkwo [8:19 A.M.]: I'll take the dock. I'm not needed at the registration desk until the buyers arrive anyway.

Harlan Voss [8:20 A.M.]: That's a relief. Let's aim to have everything up by 12:45.

Diego Ferraro [8:21 A.M.]: I'll bring extra zip ties in case the banner frames come up short again.

q.q: At 8:20 A.M., what does Mr. Voss most likely mean when he writes, "That's a relief"?
c: He is glad that Ms. Okonkwo can handle the loading dock
He is arranging for someone to be relieved of a shift
He is pleased that the banners arrived earlier than expected
He is relieved that the buyers will arrive later than planned
q.n: 直前で Nadia Okonkwo が「I'll take the dock」と積み下ろし場対応を引き受けており、Meiling を graphics から外さずに済むため Voss は安堵している。『誰かを勤務から交代させる（relieve）』は relief の別義に引っ張った罠で文脈と合わない。バナーは正午到着でまだ届いておらず『早く着いた』は本文と矛盾。バイヤーの到着時刻(1 P.M.)が遅れたという記述もない。

q.q: Who most likely is Ms. Okonkwo?
c: A technician assembling the sample shelves
The driver of the delayed freight truck
The designer of the booth graphics
A staff member assigned to greet buyers at registration
q.n: Okonkwo は「not needed at the registration desk until the buyers arrive」と述べており、受付でバイヤー対応を担当するスタッフだと分かる。貨物トラックの運転手は彼女が dock で出迎える相手（役割の付け替え）。booth graphics は Meiling、サンプル棚の組立は Diego の担当で別人。

q.q: What has Mr. Ferraro already done?
c: He met the freight truck at the loading dock
He picked up the tables the day before
He contacted the freight company about the delay
q.n: Ferraro は「The tables are already here — I picked them up yesterday」と、前日にテーブルを引き取り済み。積み下ろし場での貨物対応は Nadia、graphics は Meiling、貨物会社と連絡を取ったのは Harlan で、それぞれ他人の行動を付け替えたダミー。

q.q: Why will the banners be hung last?
c: The registration desk must be set up first
The team has run out of zip ties
The crates containing them will not arrive until noon
The product samples are considered more fragile
q.n: 冒頭で banner crates の到着が正午になると分かり、Meiling が『バナーは最後に掛けよう』と提案した理由がこの遅延。zip ties はむしろ Diego が予備を持参する予定で不足はしていない（事実の付け替え）。受付準備やサンプルの壊れやすさは掛ける順番の理由として本文に出てこない。

p7.intro: Questions 172-175 refer to the following report.

docs.b:
Prepared for: Brightfold Retail Group
Property: Maple Court Shopping Arcade, 14 Loxley Street
Prepared by: Renshaw & Petit Building Consultants
Date of inspection: 3 March
Purpose: Pre-purchase condition assessment

At the request of Brightfold Retail Group, our firm conducted a walk-through of Maple Court Shopping Arcade on 3 March. - [1] - The arcade comprises eighteen retail units arranged over two floors, connected by a central staircase and a single passenger elevator.

The building's exterior masonry is in sound condition, and the roof membrane, replaced four years ago, shows no signs of leakage. - [2] - The interior, however, presents several concerns. The passenger elevator has exceeded its recommended service life and generated three breakdown reports in the past year alone. - [3] - We therefore recommend budgeting for a full replacement rather than continued repairs.

Lighting in the lower-level corridor is also inadequate and does not meet the current commercial standard. - [4] - Overall, the property is structurally sound but will require an estimated £120,000 in upgrades within the first two years of ownership.

q.q: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "These interruptions have frustrated tenants and left shoppers stranded between floors."
q.n: 挿入文の『These interruptions（これらの中断）』はエレベーターの故障を指すので、故障報告3件を述べた直後で全面交換を勧める直前の [3] が最適。[1] は建物概要の前、[2] は外壁と屋根が良好という文脈、[4] は照明の話で、いずれも interruptions が指す先が存在しない。

q.q: Who most likely are Renshaw and Petit?
c: The current owners of Maple Court Shopping Arcade
Building consultants hired to inspect the property
Contractors who installed the passenger elevator
q.n: ヘッダーの「Prepared by: Renshaw & Petit Building Consultants」と本文「our firm conducted a walk-through」から、物件を調査した建物コンサルタントだと分かる。現所有者ではなく依頼主は Brightfold（役割の付け替え）。Brightfold の幹部でもなく、エレベーターを設置した業者でもない（むしろ交換を勧める側）。

q.q: What is the purpose of the report?
c: To announce that the roof membrane will be replaced
To advertise eighteen retail units available for lease
To document elevator repairs that have been completed
To evaluate a building's condition ahead of a possible purchase
q.n: ヘッダーの「Pre-purchase condition assessment」と Brightfold の依頼で walk-through を実施した点から、購入前の建物状態評価が目的。18区画は物件の規模説明であって賃貸募集ではない（事実の付け替え）。エレベーターは修理完了ではなく交換を勧告している段階。屋根は4年前に交換済みで今後の交換告知ではない。

q.q: What does the report indicate about the roof?
c: It has exceeded its recommended service life
Its membrane was replaced four years ago and shows no leaks
It fails to meet the current commercial standard
It will cost an estimated £120,000 to repair
q.n: 屋根膜は「replaced four years ago, shows no signs of leakage」で良好。耐用年数超過はエレベーター、現行商業基準未達は下層階の照明の記述であり、いずれも別の箇所の指摘を屋根に付け替えたダミー。£120,000 は最初の2年間に必要な改修費の総額見積りで屋根の修理費ではない。

c: To report the closing of a shop
To announce a new membership program

q.q: What does Ms. Okonkwo suggest could be improved?

q.n: メールは注文したCedarlineのスローが在庫切れだと知らせ、代替品や返金の選択肢を示すのが目的で、注文品が入手できないことの通知。まだ発送されておらず出荷確認ではない。新商品ラインの宣伝でもない。支払いはすでに済んでおり請求ではない。

q.q: What is one option offered to Ms. Overgaard?
c: A different colour of the same throw
A discount on her next purchase
Free shipping on a future order
An upgrade to a larger blanket size
q.n: 本文は今すぐ入手可能なslate greyの同じスローを送る選択肢を提示しており、同じスローの別色が正しい。次回購入割引や将来の注文の送料無料、より大きいサイズへのアップグレードはいずれも述べられていない。

q.q: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "We apologize for any inconvenience this delay may cause."
q.n: 挿入文は遅延による不便を詫びる内容で、在庫切れを告げた直後の[2]に置くと自然に繋がる。[1]は注文への礼の直後でまだ遅延が導入されていない。[3]は入荷予定日を述べた後、[4]は返信期限の後で、いずれも謝罪の流れとして遅延の言及直後より不自然。

p7.intro: Questions 159-160 refer to the following notice.

docs.h: City of Pellworth - Riverside Path Ordinance No. 214
docs.b:
This notice establishes the rules governing use of the Alderbank Riverside Path, effective October 1.

The path is reserved for pedestrians and cyclists at all times. Motorized vehicles of any kind, including electric scooters, are prohibited between the Millgrove Bridge and the Foxton Locks.

Cyclists must dismount and walk their bicycles across the three wooden footbridges along the route, as the timber decking cannot support riding loads.

Dogs are welcome but must be kept on a leash no longer than two meters. Owners are responsible for removing any waste.

The path closes at 9:00 P.M. daily. Violations of this ordinance may result in a fine of up to $150. Questions should be directed to the Pellworth Parks Office at 555-0148.

q.q: What is the purpose of the notice?
c: To announce the construction of a new riverside path
To request volunteers for a path cleanup event
To set out the regulations for using a public path
To advertise guided cycling tours along the river
q.n: 冒頭で「Alderbank Riverside Path の利用を管理する規則を定める」と明記しており、規則の告知が目的。建設の告知やボランティア募集、ツアー宣伝は本文にない付け足し。

q.q: What are cyclists required to do at the wooden footbridges?
c: Get off and walk their bicycles
q.n: 「木製の橋では自転車を降りて押して渡らねばならない」と述べている。料金や迂回路の指示はなく、motorized vehicles はそもそも全面禁止なので譲る対象にならない。

p7.intro: Questions 161-163 refer to the following article.

docs.h: Brightloom Textiles Opens Second Weaving Mill in Eastvale
docs.b:
EASTVALE - Brightloom Textiles announced on Tuesday that it has opened a second weaving mill in the Eastvale industrial district, roughly doubling the company's production capacity for its recycled-fiber fabrics.

The new facility, which cost $18 million to build, will employ 240 workers once fully staffed. Hiring began last month and is expected to conclude by December.

"Demand for our fabrics has grown faster than we ever projected, and our original mill simply could not keep pace," said Priya Venkataraman, chief executive of Brightloom. "This expansion lets us serve larger clothing brands without compromising the environmental standards that define us."

Industry analysts note that Brightloom's decision runs against a broader trend, as several rival manufacturers have moved production overseas in recent years. Venkataraman said the company remains committed to keeping its operations within the region.

q.q: What is suggested about Brightloom Textiles' original mill?
c: It produced fabrics that failed environmental standards
It will be closed once the new mill opens
It was relocated overseas last year
It was unable to meet the level of demand on its own
q.n: CEO が「元の工場では需要のペースについていけなかった」と述べており、能力不足が示唆される。閉鎖や海外移転は競合他社の話であり Brightloom には当てはまらない。環境基準は守っていると明言。

q.q: How many people will the new facility employ when fully staffed?
q.n: 「fully staffed になれば 240 人を雇用する」と明記。18 は建設費（百万ドル）の数字の付け替え。

q.q: In the article, the word "pace" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to
q.n: 「keep pace with demand（需要のペースに追いつく）」の pace は増加の速さ = rate。distance や footstep は pace の別の辞書的意味に引っ張った誤答で、この文脈では通らない。

p7.intro: Questions 164-167 refer to the following schedule.

docs.h: Harborcrest Urban Design Forum - Program of Sessions
docs.b:

q.n: 「Building With Less」のセッションで Deshmukh が「reused building materials（再利用建材）」を扱うと明記。他の登壇者はそれぞれ広場、交通、開会の担当。

c: A refund of their registration fee
A printed program at the door

q.q: When are the sofa samples expected to be delivered?

p7.intro: Questions 172-175 refer to the following report.

docs.b:
Client: Larkspur Heritage Trust
Property: The Old Custance Granary, 4 Wharf Lane
Purpose: To evaluate the building's suitability for conversion into a community arts venue

The granary, built in 1892, was inspected over two days by our survey team. - [1] - Overall, the timber frame is in sound condition, with only localized decay near the north gable where a gutter has long been leaking.

The ground floor can safely bear the loads expected of a public gallery and workshop space. - [2] - However, the upper floor joists were sized for grain storage and would require reinforcement before use as an occupied studio.

The external brickwork is largely original and structurally stable. - [3] - We recommend repointing the south wall within the next two years to prevent water ingress.

We estimate that the essential structural works could be completed within four months. - [4] - A detailed cost breakdown will follow in a separate document once the Trust confirms the intended occupancy limits.

q.q: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "That figure assumes work begins before the winter months."
q.n: 「その見積もり（figure）は冬の前に着工する前提」という文は、直前で「必須工事は4か月で完了できる」と期間を述べた [4] に自然につながる。他の位置には参照する数値がない。

q.q: Who most likely are the members of the survey team?
c: Artists planning to exhibit at the venue
Trustees of the Larkspur Heritage Trust
Grain merchants who once used the granary
q.n: この文書は建物を2日間かけて調査し木材や煉瓦の状態を評価する構造診断報告で、作成者は建物検査の専門家。Trust は依頼主（client）、芸術家や穀物商は建物の用途に関する背景で調査者ではない。

q.q: What is the purpose of the report?
c: To justify demolishing an old granary
To apply for historic protection status
To provide a final cost estimate for renovation
To assess whether a building can become an arts venue
q.n: ヘッダーの Purpose に「建物をコミュニティの芸術施設に転用する適性を評価する」と明記。詳細な費用は別文書で後述するとあり最終見積もりではない。取り壊しや歴史保護申請は本文にない。

q.q: According to the report, what work is recommended for the upper floor?
q.n: 上階の梁は穀物貯蔵用の寸法なので、スタジオとして使う前に補強が必要と述べている。repointing は南壁の煉瓦、雨樋の漏れは北側の局所的腐朽の原因で別項目。

p7.intro: Questions 181-185 refer to the following article and review.

docs.h: Cedarline Bikeshare Expands to the Waterfront District
docs.b:
Cedarline Bikeshare, the docked bicycle rental network founded in Millgrove eight years ago, announced this week that it has added twelve new stations across the Waterfront District. The expansion brings the total network to eighty-four stations.

Riders unlock bicycles using the Cedarline mobile app or a physical membership card. The company offers three plans: a Single Ride at $3.25 for thirty minutes, a Day Pass at $11.00 for unlimited thirty-minute trips within twenty-four hours, and an Annual Membership at $96.00 that includes the first forty-five minutes of every trip at no extra charge.

"Our data showed that Waterfront residents were walking up to fifteen minutes just to reach the nearest station," said operations director Ms. Lena Varga. "These new docks close that gap." Varga added that every new station includes at least four electric-assist bicycles, which had previously been available only in the downtown core.

docs.h: Customer Review — posted by Tomas Reindl
docs.b:
Rating: 4 out of 5

I live near the Waterfront and used to skip Cedarline entirely because the closest dock was a long walk from my building. Ever since the new stations went in, there is one just two minutes from my door, so I finally signed up for the plan that covers a full year.

The best surprise has been the electric-assist bikes. My commute includes a steep hill by the ferry terminal, and before, I would arrive at work out of breath. Now the ride is genuinely pleasant. My only complaint is that on weekday mornings the electric bikes at my local dock are often all taken by 8:15 A.M., so I sometimes have to settle for a standard bicycle.

Still, for the price, this is the best transit decision I have made all year.

q.q: What is indicated about Cedarline Bikeshare in the article?
c: It was founded in the Waterfront District.
It has discontinued its physical membership cards.
It plans to lower its Day Pass price.
q.n: 記事は拡張後の総数を84ステーションと述べている。創業地はMillgroveでWaterfrontではなく、会員カード廃止や料金値下げの記述もない。

q.q: Which plan did Mr. Reindl most likely purchase?
q.n: レビューで彼は「一年分をカバーするプランに加入した」と書き、記事のプラン一覧では年会員が該当する。両文書の突合が必要。単発やデイパスは一年分をカバーしない。

q.q: What feature does Mr. Reindl praise most in his review?
c: The low cost of the Single Ride
q.n: レビューは電動アシスト自転車を最大の驚きと称賛している。単発料金やアプリ、接客には触れていない。

q.q: What can be inferred about the electric-assist bicycles near Mr. Reindl's home?
c: They were available at his dock before the expansion.
They became available at his dock only after the expansion.
They are limited to downtown riders.
q.n: 記事は電動アシストが以前は都心のみだったが新ステーション各所に配備されたと述べ、レビューでは彼の近くのステーションが新設だと分かる。二文書を組み合わせると拡張後に初めて彼の近くで使えるようになったと分かる。以前から使えたは逆の引っかけ。

q.q: What is one drawback Mr. Reindl mentions?
c: The electric bikes are often gone by early morning.
The stations are too far from his home.
The annual fee increased this year.
The app frequently fails to unlock bikes.
q.n: レビューは平日朝8時15分までに電動自転車が出払うことを唯一の不満としている。むしろステーションは近くなったと述べており、値上げやアプリ不具合には言及がない。

p7.intro: Questions 151-153 refer to the following notice.

docs.h: NOTICE -- Attention Lanthorn Museum Guides and Volunteers
docs.b:
Beginning 4 October, the east wing will close while the Calverstoke Textile Collection is rehoused in new climate-controlled cases. -- [1] -- Tours that normally end in the east wing will finish in the sculpture court instead, and each guide should add roughly ten minutes of walking time to the standard route.

We expect visitor numbers to rise once the collection reopens, because several pieces have never been displayed publicly. -- [2] -- For that reason, we are extending Saturday guide shifts from four hours to six. -- [3] -- Volunteers who cannot take the longer shift should tell the desk before 20 September so that pairs can be rearranged.

Printed route maps in the guides' room are being replaced this week. -- [4] -- Please discard any copy dated before September; the old maps still show the east wing as open.

Mr. Kwame Owusu
Volunteer Coordinator, Lanthorn Museum

q.q: What is one purpose of the notice?
c: To announce the hiring of additional guides
To request donations for new display cases
To publicize the opening of a new wing
To explain a change to a walking route
q.n: east wing が閉まるため、ツアーの終点が sculpture court に変わり、所要の歩行時間が十分増えると説明している。つまり見学経路の変更の周知が目的の一つ。ガイドの増員は募っておらず、cases は既に導入されるもので寄付の依頼はない。新設の翼が開くのではなく、既存の翼が一時閉鎖される。

q.q: What is indicated about the Calverstoke Textile Collection?
c: It was assembled by museum volunteers.
It will be moved to the sculpture court permanently.
Parts of it have not been shown to the public before.
It has been on display since September.
q.n: several pieces have never been displayed publicly とあるので、一部は未公開だったと分かる。sculpture court はツアーの新しい終点であって収蔵先ではない。所蔵品を volunteers が集めたという記述はない。September は古い route maps の日付の基準であり、展示開始時期ではない。

q.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"The extra two hours will therefore cover the busiest part of the afternoon."
q.n: The extra two hours という定冠詞つきの主語が、土曜の担当時間を four hours から six へ延ばすという直前の文を受けており、therefore がその帰結を示す。したがって置き場所はその文の直後で、続く the longer shift を取れない人への案内にも自然につながる。閉鎖と経路変更の間の位置には勤務時間の話がまだ出ておらず、未公開作品と来館者増の間の位置も same で、どちらも extra two hours が何を指すか決まらない。route maps の段落は話題が切り替わっているので入らない。

q.n: Salary is 34,000 pounds annually, with a review after six months の文脈では、半年後に給与を見直すための評価を指すので assessment が最も近い。opinion は個人の見解、summary は要約、inspection は設備や現物の点検を指し、いずれもここでの給与見直しの意味にはならない。

p7.intro: Questions 172-175 refer to the following article.

docs.h:
Lundermere Business Weekly
Wychcombe Suites Reviews Its Station Shuttle
By Constanta Zelenka
docs.b:
LUNDERMERE (30 September)—Guests who book Wychcombe Suites through the hotel's website are offered a free shuttle to the rail station, and the van has been running every hour since April. — [1] — Over the summer, however, ridership fell to nine passengers a day, well under the twenty the hotel had planned for. — [2] —

Ms. Adaeze Dlamini, the operations analyst who reviewed the service, traces the drop to a mismatch rather than a lack of interest. The van leaves on the hour, while the express trains leave at twenty past. — [3] — Several guests told front desk staff they had simply walked instead, though the walk takes twenty-five minutes with luggage.

Ms. Dlamini has recommended moving departures to five minutes past the hour and adding a second van on Fridays. — [4] — Both changes can be made within the current transport budget, she said, and she has asked the front desk to record boarding numbers for six weeks so that the effect can be judged before the winter season.

q.q: What is indicated about the shuttle service?
c: It costs guests a small fare.
It has been running since the winter.
It carries fewer guests than expected.
It stops at several hotels in Lundermere.
q.n: ridership fell to nine passengers a day, well under the twenty the hotel had planned for とある。見込みの二十人を大きく下回っている、つまり想定より利用者が少ない。free shuttle とあるので運賃は取っていない。運行開始は April で冬ではない。複数のホテルを回るという記述はない。

q.q: According to the article, why do some guests walk to the station?
q.n: バンは毎時ちょうどに出るのに急行は twenty past に出るため間があき、それを嫌って歩いた客がいた、という流れ。待ち時間を避けるため。シャトルは無料なので運賃の節約にはならない。運動が目的とも書かれていない。荷物を持つと二十五分かかるとあり、荷物は歩く動機ではなく負担の側。

q.q: What is suggested about Ms. Dlamini's recommendations?
c: They will require a larger transport budget.
They have already been approved by the front desk.
They will take effect after the winter season.
They can be carried out without extra funding.
q.n: Both changes can be made within the current transport budget とある。今の予算の枠内で収まる、つまり追加の資金は要らない。予算を増やす必要があるとする選択肢は本文と逆。front desk に頼んでいるのは乗車人数の記録であって、承認をもらったという記述ではない。効果を判断するのは before the winter season で、冬の後ではない。

q.q: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "The result is a twenty-minute gap at the busiest part of the morning."
q.n: The result は直前の文を受ける。バンが毎時ちょうど、急行が twenty past という時刻のずれを述べた文の直後に置くと、二十分の空きという結果が自然につながり、その後の「だから歩いた客がいた」も受けられる。運行開始を述べただけの箇所や、利用者数の落ち込みで段落が閉じる箇所には、まだ時刻のずれが出ていないので入らない。出発を五分過ぎに動かす提案の直後では、ずれを解消した話の後で二十分の空きを言うことになり矛盾する。

q.n: 会報の Tours の項に Ms. Ana Valdivieso will lead とあり、直後の項で a second guide will be needed from July と、ツアーを lead する人を guide と呼んでいる。よってツアーの案内役。倉庫の項は搬入口の閉鎖という別件で彼女への言及はない。会報は蒸留所の社内向けで、来訪する団体は Ellingsworth 側の人間であり彼女は迎える側。

p7.intro: Questions 147-148 refer to the following text-message chain.

docs.b:
Ines Prado [7:42 A.M.]: Morning, Kwabena. The guest in 508 wants to check out an hour early. Has your team reached the fifth floor?

Kwabena Osei [7:44 A.M.]: Not yet. We started on three because of the tour group.

Ines Prado [7:45 A.M.]: They are leaving at nine, and the next booking for that room arrives at eleven.

Kwabena Osei [7:47 A.M.]: I can move two people up as soon as 312 is finished.

Ines Prado [7:48 A.M.]: Would that push the tour group's rooms past noon?

Kwabena Osei [7:49 A.M.]: Their coach is not back until two.

Ines Prado [7:50 A.M.]: Then go ahead. I will hold the key card until you tell me the room is ready.

Kwabena Osei [7:51 A.M.]: Give me forty minutes.

q.q: At 7:49 A.M., what does Mr. Osei most likely mean when he writes, "Their coach is not back until two"?
c: The tour group's rooms can be cleaned later in the day.
A different vehicle will have to be arranged.
He will not be able to help until the afternoon.
The tour group has decided to stay another night.
q.n: 直前でフロントは、5階を先にやると団体客の部屋が正午を過ぎないかと心配している。それに対してバスが2時まで戻らないと答えているので、団体客はそれまで部屋に戻らず、後回しにしても支障が無いという意味になる。車両を手配し直す話はどこにも出ていない。宿泊延長の話も出ていない。作業を午後に回すのは団体客の部屋の方で、頼まれた5階は40分でやると答えている。

q.q: What is suggested about room 508?
c: It was booked by the tour group.
It is located on the third floor.
It has already been cleaned this morning.
It will be used by another guest the same day.
q.n: 今の客が9時前に出ること、そしてその部屋の次の予約が11時に入ることの二つを合わせると、同じ日のうちに別の客が入ると分かる。3階は団体客のために清掃を先に始めた階で、508号室は5階にある。5階はまだ手つかずで、これから2人を回すところ。団体客が押さえているのは清掃を先に進めた階の部屋で、508号室ではない。

p7.intro: Questions 151-153 refer to the following web page.

docs.h: www.kelsodistrict.gov/depot     Home | Collections | Depot | Fees | Contact
docs.b:
Kelso District Household Waste Depot

Open Wednesday to Sunday, 8:00 A.M. to 4:30 P.M. Closed on public holidays.

Residents may bring garden waste, timber, metal, batteries, and small appliances at no charge. Proof of address is checked at the barrier; a utility bill or a driving licence is accepted.

Paint, solvents, and garden chemicals are taken on the first Saturday of each month only, between 9:00 A.M. and noon.

Rubble, soil, and plasterboard are chargeable: GBP 4.50 per sack or GBP 28.00 per trailer load. Payment is by card at the weighbridge. The depot does not handle cash.

Vehicles and trailers longer than three metres require a permit, which must be requested online at least two working days before the visit.

q.q: What is one purpose of the Web page?
c: To announce a change in collection days
To recruit staff for a new depot
To set out the conditions for using a facility
q.n: 開場日時、持ち込めるもの、確認される書類、料金と支払い方法、大型車の許可と、施設を使うときの条件が並んでいる。収集日の変更を知らせる文はどこにも無い。求人の記述も無い。意見を求める呼びかけも無い。

q.q: What are residents asked to show at the barrier?
c: A receipt for the items being disposed of
A printed copy of their permit
Proof that payment has been made
q.n: 入口で確認されるのは住所を証明するもので、公共料金の請求書か運転免許証が使えると書かれている。処分する品物の領収書は求められていない。許可が要るのは3メートルを超える車両だけで、しかも入口で紙を見せるという記述は無い。支払いは入口ではなく計量所でカード払いする。

q.q: What is suggested about a resident who arrives with leftover paint on a Wednesday?
c: The resident may leave the paint outside the barrier.
The resident will need to come back on a different day.
The resident will be charged by the sack.
The resident must apply for a permit first.
q.n: 塗料を受け入れるのは毎月第1土曜の午前中だけなので、水曜に持ち込んでも引き取ってもらえず、日を改める必要がある。袋単位で料金がかかるのはがれきや土、石膏ボードで、塗料の料金の記述は無い。許可が要るのは大型車を入れる場合。門の外に置いていってよいとはどこにも書かれていない。

p7.intro: Questions 156-158 refer to the following notice.

docs.b:

During that period, residents of floors five to nine may use the service lift at the rear of the building between 7:00 A.M. and 9:00 P.M. — [2] —. A key fob is needed to call it, and fobs may be collected from the caretaker's office this week. — [3] —.

Ferran Oduya, Building Manager

q.q: What are residents asked to do this week?
c: Move large items out of the stairwell
Book a time with the contractor
Pick up a device that operates a lift
Confirm which floor they live on
q.n: 今週のうちに管理人室で受け取るよう求められているのは、業務用エレベーターを呼ぶための鍵。大きな荷物は階段室から出すのではなく、平日の午前に搬入の予約を入れるよう案内している。住んでいる階を届け出る手続きは書かれていない。工事業者と時間を打ち合わせるのではなく、搬入の予約先は建物側。

q.q: What is suggested about residents of the third floor?
c: They must use the rear entrance.
They will be charged for the repairs.
They will not be given a key fob.
q.n: 業務用エレベーターを使えるのは5階から9階の住人と限られており、3階はその範囲に入らない。鍵を配る相手も同じ範囲になる。裏口を使うよう指示されているのは建物ではなくエレベーターの位置の説明で、出入口の変更は書かれていない。搬入を断るとも、費用を住人に請求するとも述べていない。

q.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Outside those hours, the stairs are the only way to reach the upper floors."
q.n: those hours という定冠詞つきの語句が、直前に示された午前7時から午後9時までという時間帯を受けている。したがって置き場所はその時間帯を示した文の直後。工期を述べた文の後ろにはまだ時間帯が出ていない。鍵の配布を述べた文の後ろでは、間に別の話題が入って those hours が何を指すか決まらなくなる。搬入の段落は時間帯が平日の午前に切り替わっており、上の階へ上がる手段の話につながらない。

p7.intro: Questions 159-162 refer to the following brochure.

docs.b:
The museum occupies the original 1878 engine shed at Calder Vale, twenty minutes by bus from Preston station. Three of the six locomotives on display were built in the shed itself.

Galleries
The Turntable Hall holds the working locomotives. The Signal Room, upstairs, lets visitors pull the levers that once controlled eleven kilometres of track. The Workshop opens at weekends only, when volunteers rebuild carriage interiors and answer questions while they work.

Steam days
On the first and third Sunday of every month from April to October, one locomotive is fired up and pulls short rides along the yard. Ride tickets are sold on the day and cannot be reserved.

Admission
Adults GBP 9.00, children under sixteen GBP 4.00, families GBP 22.00. Members enter free. Membership costs GBP 30.00 a year and includes the quarterly magazine Vale Steam.

The cafe in the old ticket office serves hot food until 3:00 P.M. The site has no car park, but buses stop at the gate every twenty minutes.

q.q: What is stated about the Workshop?
c: It can be seen only on Saturdays and Sundays.
It is located on the upper floor.
It closes during the summer months.
q.n: 作業場が開くのは週末だけで、そのときは有志が客車の内装を直しながら質問にも答えると書かれている。上の階にあるのは信号室。別料金が要るという記述は無く、当日券が要るのは蒸気機関車の乗車。夏に閉まるどころか、4月から10月が蒸気の運転期間にあたる。

q.q: What is suggested about visitors who want to take a train ride?
c: They must join the museum first.
They should book their tickets a month ahead.
They have to choose a particular Sunday for their visit.
They can ride at any time the museum is open.
q.n: 機関車を動かすのは4月から10月までの第1と第3日曜だけなので、乗るつもりなら訪問日をその日曜に合わせる必要がある。乗車券は当日売りで予約もできないので、1カ月前の手配はできない。会員でなければ乗れないとは書かれておらず、会員の特典は入館料と会報。開館日ならいつでも乗れるわけではない。

q.q: What is NOT mentioned as available at the museum?
q.n: 夜の案内ツアーには一言も触れていない。食事は旧切符売り場の食堂で午後3時まで出る。会員には季刊の会報が付く。信号室では来館者が実際にレバーを引ける。

q.q: What is suggested about getting to the museum?
c: The site can be reached on foot from the station.
A shuttle runs only on steam days.
Parking must be paid for at the gate.
Most visitors are expected to arrive by bus.
q.n: 駐車場が無いこと、そして門の前に20分おきにバスが停まることの二つを合わせると、来館者はバスで来ることが前提になっていると分かる。駅からは徒歩ではなくバスで20分。駐車場そのものが無いので料金の話にならない。専用の送迎便があるとは書かれていない。

p7.intro: Questions 163-164 refer to the following e-mail.

c: It packs its goods in printed cartons.

q.q: What is indicated about the boxes that were sent?
c: They will arrive later than the rest of the order.
They are made from recycled material.
They were requested by the customer.
They cost the customer no more than the ones ordered.

p7.intro: Questions 165-168 refer to the following article.

docs.h: Bakery Chain Opens Its Own Training School
docs.b:
HALIFAX (18 January)—Pomerol Bakeries, which runs nineteen shops across the province, has opened a training school on the floor above its Water Street branch. — [1] —. The company says it could not find enough qualified bakers to staff the four shops it intends to open by 2028.

The school takes twelve students at a time. — [2] —. Each course runs for sixteen weeks and costs the student nothing, on the condition that graduates stay with the company for at least a year afterwards. Students are paid a small wage while they train.

"We were competing for the same forty or fifty people every spring," said Delphine Sarr, who founded the chain in 2009. — [3] —. "Now we train our own."

The first group finished in December. Ten of the twelve took jobs at Pomerol; the other two joined a hotel kitchen in the same city. Ms. Sarr says the loss does not trouble her. — [4] —.

Applications for the spring course close on 28 February.

q.q: According to the article, what are graduates of the course required to do?
c: Pass an examination in the spring
Work for the company for a set period
Repay the cost of their training
Move to one of the new shops
q.n: 受講料が無料になる条件として、修了後1年以上は会社に残ることが挙げられている。費用の返済は求められておらず、そもそも学生の負担はゼロ。試験に触れた記述は無い。新店舗への異動を義務づける文も無い。

q.q: What is suggested about Pomerol Bakeries?
c: It sells its bread to other bakeries.
It intends to expand over the next few years.
It was founded by a hotel chef.
It has recently closed several shops.
q.n: 2028年までに4店を出す計画があり、その人手が確保できないことが学校を作った理由だと述べられている。閉店の話は出ていない。創業者はホテルの料理人ではなく、ホテルの厨房に移ったのは1期生2人。他店への卸売りの記述も無い。

q.q: What is indicated about the first group of students?
c: They were taught at the Water Street shop counter.
All of them completed the course early.
Most of them were hired by the bakery chain.
q.n: 12人のうち10人がこの会社に就職しており、大半が採用されたことになる。修了は12月で、早く終えたという記述は無い。受講料は割引ではなく無料。教室があるのは店の売り場ではなく、その上の階。

q.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Even the ones who leave will have learned the trade here."
q.n: the ones who leave が、修了生12人のうち他所へ移った2人を受けており、Even で始まる文が「気にしていない」という直前の発言の理由になっている。したがって置き場所はその発言の直後。学校を開いたことを述べた文の後ろにはまだ修了生が出ていない。定員を述べた文の後ろも同じ。創業者の発言の間に挟むと、引用符の中の話が途切れて意味が通らなくなる。

p7.intro: Questions 169-171 refer to the following event program.

q.q: In the program, the word "allocated" is closest in meaning to
q.n: 定員20名の枠を申し込み順に割り当てるという文脈なので、割り振るという意味の assigned が最も近い。divided は一つのものを分割する意味で、席を人に振り分ける動作を表さない。counted は数える動作。postponed は先送りにする意味で、いずれもこの文の内容にならない。

q.q: What are attendees asked to do when they book?
c: Submit a question for the panel
Choose one of the two morning talks
Say in advance if they want a meal without meat
q.n: 肉を使わない昼食は予約時に申し出る必要があり、当日の追加はできないと明記されている。午前の2つの講演は時間帯が違うので選ぶ必要は無い。質問は当日に各自が持ち寄る形。証明が要るのは会員ではなく学生で、しかも予約時とは書かれていない。

q.q: What is suggested about the 13:30 session?
c: It costs more than the other sessions.
It is intended for commercial producers.
It may be full before the day of the meeting.
It will be repeated in the afternoon.

p7.intro: Questions 172-175 refer to the following online chat discussion.

docs.b:
Priya Raghunathan [2:04 P.M.]: The fair has sent the stand plan. We are on a corner this year, six metres by four.

Tomas Ek [2:06 P.M.]: A corner suits us. We can open two sides and drop the back wall entirely.

Priya Raghunathan [2:07 P.M.]: The back wall is where the sample lengths hang. If it goes, we need something that stands on its own.

Hanna Virtanen [2:09 P.M.]: The folding rails we used in Ghent are in the store room behind the dye shop.

Tomas Ek [2:10 P.M.]: Are those the ones with the broken feet?

Hanna Virtanen [2:11 P.M.]: Two of the six, yes. The workshop can turn new feet in an afternoon.

Priya Raghunathan [2:12 P.M.]: Then it is settled, if the workshop has an afternoon. They are finishing the Aalborg order this week.

Tomas Ek [2:14 P.M.]: I will ask them today. If the answer is no, we build the back wall and lose the second opening.

Hanna Virtanen [2:15 P.M.]: Tell me either way before Friday. The freight booking closes then, and the rails change the volume.

q.q: At 2:12 P.M., what does Ms. Raghunathan most likely mean when she writes, "if the workshop has an afternoon"?
c: She doubts that the workshop can spare the time.
She is asking when the workshop opens.
She wants the repair done in the morning instead.
She thinks the workshop should hire more staff.
q.n: 直前で、脚は半日あれば作れると言われている。それに対して、その半日が空いていればという条件を付け、続けて今週は別の注文で手一杯だと理由を添えている。時間を取れるかどうかを疑っている発言になる。午前に前倒しする話も、人を増やす話も出ていない。開く時刻を尋ねているのでもない。

q.q: What does Mr. Ek offer to do?
c: Redraw the plan for the stand
Collect the rails from the store room
Find out whether some repairs can be made
q.n: 壊れた脚を作り直せるかどうかを工房に確認すると自分から申し出ている。倉庫にあることを知らせたのは別の担当者で、運び出すとは誰も言っていない。図面は主催者から届いたもので、引き直す話は出ていない。輸送の締め切りは金曜のままで、延ばす提案は誰もしていない。

q.q: What is suggested about the design of the stand?
c: It depends on whether the folding rails can be used.
It will be smaller than last year's stand.
It has already been approved by the fair.
It requires a wall on all four sides.
q.n: 脚が直れば背面の壁を外して2面を開ける、直らなければ壁を立てて開口を1面に減らすと述べられており、間仕切りに使う折りたたみラックが使えるかどうかで構成が変わる。主催者が承認したのは区画の割り当てで、内部の設計ではない。広さを昨年と比べた記述は無い。四方を壁で囲むという話も出ていない。

q.q: Why does Ms. Virtanen ask to be told before Friday?
c: The store room is being cleared out.

The workshop closes for a holiday.
She will be away the following week.

Permits for next year must be applied for by 14 November. All permits run from 1 January to 31 December.

Suki Hallberg, Site Services

q.q: What is indicated about the permits?

q.n: 屋根付きの駐輪場には充電用の差込口が6か所あると書かれている。修理台には触れていない。番号付きの区画があるのは正面と北側の車の区画。夜間の警備員の記述も無い。

q.q: Why did Ms. Iyer write to Ms. Hallberg?
c: To ask for an extension of the deadline
To have a submitted application changed
To arrange a space for a visitor

q.q: Which permit will Ms. Iyer most likely be issued?
q.n: 掲示では、自宅が40キロを超える職員に北側の屋根付き区画を出すとある。メールでは新居までの距離が片道48キロだと述べているので、この条件に当てはまる。正面の区画は役職者と障害者証の所持者向け。裏の草地の区画は今持っているもので、変更を申し出た元の側にあたる。自転車で通うとはどこにも書いていない。

q.q: What will Ms. Iyer have to do before the new permit is issued?

Submit proof of her new address
q.n: 掲示に、年度の途中で区分を変える職員は古い許可証を受付に返してからでないと新しいものを受け取れないとある。メールから、今持っているのが3号棟裏の草地の許可証だと分かるので、返すのはそれになる。手数料の記載は無い。住所の証明を出すよう求める記述も無い。2台目の登録の話も出ていない。

p7.intro: Questions 191-195 refer to the following article, e-mail, and schedule.

docs.h: Fenwick Short Film Festival Moves to the Old Malthouse
docs.b:
FENWICK (3 March)—The Fenwick Short Film Festival, now in its ninth year, will leave the town hall this September for the Old Malthouse on Wharf Road. The hall seated ninety; the malthouse has four screening rooms and 220 seats in total.

Entries from outside the region rose by 40 percent last year, and the festival turned away more than a hundred films for want of space.

This year's festival runs from 12 to 14 September. Entries close on 30 June and are judged in four categories: documentary, animation, drama, and student work. Director Aoife Mullan says the last day will again be given over to the winning films.

Tickets go on sale on 1 August. A pass covering all three days costs 30 pounds, and single sessions are 6 pounds.

docs.h: Bikes take over the last mile

HALIFAX (3 April)—Marram Couriers will move its downtown deliveries onto electric cargo bikes by the end of June, replacing six of the nine vans that now serve the port district. — [1] —

The company began testing two bikes in November, after the city narrowed Chandler Street to a single traffic lane. Riders matched the daily stop count of the van drivers in four of the five test weeks, and parking fines for the tested routes fell to zero. — [2] —

"The vans were spending more time hunting for a space than driving," said operations manager Kofi Mensah. — [3] — Marram has ordered eight bikes from a manufacturer in Aarhus and will turn part of its Water Lane garage into a charging bay. — [4] —

Drivers who now work the downtown routes have been offered training on the bikes or a transfer to the airport contract, which keeps its vans.

q.q: According to the article, what led the company to begin its test?
c: A rise in the price of fuel
A change to a downtown street
A request from an airport client
q.n: 試験を始めたのは市が道路の車線を1本に絞った後だと本文にある。燃料費の話は出てこない。運転手が足りないという記述もなく、記事に出る運転手は配置転換を打診されている側。空港の契約は今もバンを使い続ける仕事として最後に触れられているだけで、試験の理由ではない。

q.q: What is indicated about the riders during the test?
c: They kept pace with the vans in most weeks.
They delivered only to the port district.
They worked longer hours than the drivers.
They were hired from outside the company.
q.n: 5週のうち4週で1日あたりの配達件数がバンと同じだったとあるので、大半の週で遅れを取らなかったと分かる。勤務時間の比較は書かれていない。外部から採用したという記述も無い。港湾地区は今バンが担当している区域で、試験の配達先を港湾地区に限ったとは述べていない。

q.q: What is suggested about the drivers on the downtown routes?
c: They must buy bicycles of their own.
They have been moved to the port district.
They can stay with the company if they wish.
They will all lose their jobs in June.
q.n: 自転車の講習を受けるか空港の仕事に移るかを選べると示されているので、会社に残る道が用意されている。6月は自転車への切り替えが終わる時期で、全員が職を失うとは書かれていない。自転車は会社が8台発注しており、本人が買う話ではない。港湾地区は今バンが走っている区域で、そこへ移ったとは述べていない。

q.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"The three remaining vans will cover deliveries outside the city centre."
q.n: The three remaining vans という定冠詞つきの主語が、9台のうち6台を置き換えるという直前の文の引き算の答えを受けている。したがって置き場所はその文の直後。駐車違反の話の後ろに置くと、台数の内訳が出た段落から離れて残り3台が何を指すか決まらない。発言の引用の直後や、発注と充電設備の話の後ろも同じで、いずれも直前の文とつながらない。

p7.intro: Questions 155-156 refer to the following text-message chain.

docs.b:
Hyerin Kwon [11:12 A.M.]: Piotr, the projector in the boardroom will not switch on. We have nine visitors coming at two.

Piotr Zawadzki [11:15 A.M.]: The bulb went last Thursday. The replacement is not due until Wednesday.

Hyerin Kwon [11:16 A.M.]: Could we use the training room instead?

Piotr Zawadzki [11:18 A.M.]: It seats six, and the sales team has it booked until three.

Hyerin Kwon [11:19 A.M.]: So the boardroom it is. Can you bring the wheeled screen up?

Piotr Zawadzki [11:21 A.M.]: There is a spare projector in the workshop. It is heavy, but it works.

Hyerin Kwon [11:22 A.M.]: That would save us. When could it be ready?

Piotr Zawadzki [11:24 A.M.]: Half past twelve, if the cable is still with it.

q.q: At 11:19 A.M., what does Ms. Kwon most likely mean when she writes, "So the boardroom it is"?
c: The meeting will be held in the original room.
The training room will be held for her group.
She will ask the sales team to give up a booking.
She has decided to postpone the visit.
q.n: 直前で、代わりに使えないかと尋ねた部屋は定員6名でしかも3時まで先約があると告げられている。それを受けての発言なので、最初の部屋のまま進めるという意味になる。来客の予定を延ばす話は出ていない。定員と先約を聞いた直後なので、その部屋を確保するという読み方は前の発言とぶつかる。営業チームに空けてもらう依頼も、続く画面の持ち込みの相談と合わない。

q.q: What is indicated about the training room?
c: It has no screen of its own.
It will be free after two o'clock.
It is being repaired this week.
It is too small for the expected group.
q.n: 来客が9名であることと、その部屋が6名までであることを合わせると、人数に対して手狭だと分かる。画面の有無は話に出ていない。先約が入っているのは3時までで、2時に空くわけではない。修理中なのは部屋ではなく会議室の投影機で、こちらは球が切れて交換部品を待っている。

p7.intro: Questions 157-159 refer to the following web page.

docs.h: www.quarrymillcentre.be/rooms   |   Home   |   Rooms   |   Catering   |   Getting here   |   Contact
docs.b:
QUARRYMILL CENTRE — MEETING ROOMS

Quarrymill Centre occupies a restored stone mill five minutes on foot from the main railway station in Ghent. Our four rooms are let by the half day.

The Weir Room seats fourteen around a single table and has one wall of whiteboard glass. The Kiln Room takes up to forty in rows and includes a low stage. The Loft holds twenty-five and opens onto a terrace. The Millrace Room, the smallest, seats eight and is often used for interviews.

Half-day hire starts at EUR 120. Bookings for Fridays carry a EUR 20 reduction until 31 March.

q.q: What is one purpose of the Web page?
c: To advertise a course for tour guides
To describe spaces that can be hired
To announce the reopening of a mill
To give directions to a railway station
q.n: 4つの部屋の広さと備品、半日の料金を並べており、借り手に貸室の中身を示すページ。建物が改装された石造りの水車小屋だという説明は場所の紹介にすぎず、再開の告知ではない。講座の案内もない。駅から徒歩5分という記述は所在地の説明で、駅への行き方を教えるページではない。

q.q: What is provided in all four rooms?
q.n: 画面とマイク、そして飲み放題のコーヒーはどの部屋にも付くと書かれている。低い舞台が付くのは40名まで入る部屋だけ。テラスに出られるのは25名の部屋だけ。固定回線は生中継を予定する団体が10日前までに申し出たときに引く設備で、標準の備品ではない。

q.q: What is suggested about groups that plan to send live video?
c: They cannot book on a Friday.
They need to contact the centre in advance.
They are charged a higher hire rate.
They must use the largest room.
q.n: 10日前までに知らせれば固定回線を引くとあるので、事前の連絡が要ると分かる。料金が上がるという記述は無く、示されているのは半日120ユーロという開始価格だけ。部屋の指定もされていない。金曜は3月末まで20ユーロ引きになる曜日で、予約できない曜日ではない。

p7.intro: Questions 160-161 refer to the following customer review.

docs.b:
Product: Ridgeline task chair, mesh back
Reviewer: Bianca Moretti, Turin
Rating: 4 out of 5

I bought six of these chairs for a small studio after trying one in the showroom. Assembly took eleven minutes each, and the tools come in the box.

q.q: What is suggested about the chairs Ms. Moretti received?
c: They were bought for a home office.
They feel different from the one she tested.
They were delivered without any tools.
They were put together by the seller.
q.n: 展示品より背もたれの網が硬いと書いているので、店で試した一脚と届いた品では座り心地が違うと分かる。工具は箱に入っていたと明記されている。組み立ては本人が1脚11分でやっている。買った先は小さなスタジオで、自宅の仕事部屋とは書かれていない。

q.q: Why did Ms. Moretti give the product less than a full rating?
c: The showroom staff gave poor advice.
The order arrived in several shipments.
Two chairs were damaged in transit.
A refund request was turned down.
q.n: 最後の段落で、3つの箱に分かれて9日かけて届いたことを挙げ、減点したのは梱包に対してだと自分で言っている。返金は1時間以内の返信とともに応じられており、断られていない。破損の話は出てこない。展示品に触れているのは硬さの比較で、店員の説明に不満を述べてはいない。

p7.intro: Questions 162-164 refer to the following notice.

docs.h: ATTENTION QUILLON HOUSE TENANTS AND STAFF
docs.b:
Work to modernise the two passenger lifts will begin on Monday 6 July and is expected to last nine weeks. — [1] — Only one lift will be out of service at a time.

Building Manager, Ostrander Property Services

q.q: What will be required for some deliveries during the work?
c: A limit of two items per floor
A signature from the building manager
A booking made with the concierge
q.n: 25キロを超える荷物は受付に予約を入れることと決められている。管理者の署名を求める記述は無い。ロビーで扱うのは郵便物の仕分けで、荷物の引き取り場所ではない。1フロアあたりの個数制限も書かれていない。

q.q: What is NOT mentioned as a change during the work?
c: A reduction in tenants' service charges
A new place for sorting post
Earlier closing of the loading bay
Longer opening of the rear stairwell
q.n: 料金の減額には一言も触れていない。搬入口が午後6時から3時に早まること、裏の階段が午後9時まで解錠されること、郵便の仕分けが各階からロビーに移ることは、いずれも2段落目に並んでいる。

q.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"These arrangements will end as soon as the second lift returns to service."
q.n: These arrangements という指示語つきの主語が、2段落目に並べた変更点をひとまとめに受けている。したがって置き場所はその一覧が出そろった直後。工期を告げた文の後ろにはまだ変更点が1つも出ていない。搬入口の1件だけを述べた地点では、これらと呼べるだけの項目がそろっていない。運搬の相談先を示した後ろに置くと、直前の依頼手続きを指しているように読めてしまう。

p7.intro: Questions 165-167 refer to the following job advertisement.

docs.b:
Osprey Cold Store holds fruit and dairy for eleven wholesalers at our Bergen site. We are looking for a shift coordinator to run the loading floor from 10:00 P.M. to 6:00 A.M., four nights a week.

The role
